name: SushiSwap V3
description: SushiSwap V3: A Uniswap V3 fork

methodology.Fees: Each pool charge between 0.01% to 1% fee
methodology.Revenue: 0 to 1/4 of the fee goes to treasury
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Treasury receives a share of the fees
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Share of swap fee goes to xSUSHI stakers.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers get most of the fees of all trades in their pools
